title: corpus/gameability/P-NNN.json
description: A gameability probe's degenerate response (AD-9, AD-19): the compliant-looking answer, one command response per interaction plan step, which tea-evaluate run answers the plan from with no target launched. eval-quality keeps the probe's degenerateResponse as prose, so the bytes live here, in the corpus. tea-evaluate check requires one entry for every plan step and no other, and refuses an exit code the step's registry entry declares as infrastructure. The tea-evaluate runtime owns this schema.

steps.description: The response each plan step receives, by its stepId.

stdout.description: What the step prints to standard output.

stderr.description: What the step prints to standard error.
